svg.title: One turn: all gates precede response release and memory commit
svg.desc: One turn: all gates precede response release and memory commit. Boundaries describe application responsibilities; model judgments remain fallible.

g.text: One turn: all gates precede response release and memory commit
Global cap rejects excess work immediately.
Foreign sessions fail before any model call.
[uncertain, malicious, irrelevant, missing route or malformed]
fixed specialist rules + language + untrusted JSON
inspect exact candidate and original context
Always release slots; completed requests append metadata + selected specialist.
Three model calls on an ordinary successful turn.
No raw checkpoint or early token streaming.
Post-run LLM auditing runs only in the synthetic evaluation harness.
InputEvidence.relevant rejects unrelated and mixed-topic requests.
OutputEvidence.in_scope checks the current request and draft.
A schema-valid judgment can still misclassify either one.
Web session/CSRF sequence is documented separately in diagram 09.
Agentic Drink Book | Policy 2.1.0 | Model judgments remain fallible
